findings.currentValue: Evidence required. Normally one application per rolling 12 months, even if a previous application was declined. Awards are discretionary.
findings.proposedValue: Evidence required. One application per rolling 12 months, even if declined. For couples, an application by either partner counts towards this limit; it does not apply to other adult household members. Awards are discretionary.
findings.reason: The council states a firm rolling limit and partner restriction omitted from the current text.
findings.evidence: Council says an application from either partner counts for the 12-month period, while other adults in the household are not subject to this partner rule.

findings.currentValue: Use the online contact form or call and say “Adult Social Care”.
findings.proposedValue: Complete the online form for yourself or someone else. If you have difficulty with the form, need urgent support or are concerned about immediate safety, call and say “Adult Social Care”.
findings.reason: The council specifies when to use the telephone route rather than listing it as a general alternative.
findings.evidence: The council directs requests to the online form and gives the contact number for form difficulties, urgent needs or immediate safety concerns.
